title: ATS Sistemas — Core Experience

creditRates._fonte: Estimativa: indicador do Dreamina lido por terceiros em 2026-09-03. Confirmar no Dreamina antes de gerar.

styleLock: Dark cinematic technology film. Deep near-black space lit only by self-emissive light. Brand palette: cyan #29ABE2 and electric blue #00D4FF as the dominant light, violet #A855F7 as the only secondary accent, cool white #EAF6FF only at the hottest points. Precise, engineered, calm; fine volumetric glow and sparse floating particles; shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look; photoreal render quality; 24 fps.

shots.title: Núcleo — a esfera ATS se abre
shots.source: produção anterior do site (public/cinematic/nucleus, 120 frames WebP 540×960)
shots.note: Identidade preservada: a esfera metálica com ATS em ciano que se abre e revela o núcleo de energia. Seu último quadro é a referência de cor e luz de todas as cenas novas.

shots.title: Inteligência — sinapses de luz
shots.objective: Dar textura orgânica e volumétrica à rede Pessoas + IA + Engenharia que o 3D desenha: filamentos de luz que o WebGL não consegue fazer com a mesma riqueza.
shots.goal: Abstract filaments of light branching outward from a single hot white-cyan energy core into a delicate neural lattice, on pure black.

references.role: only the colour, temperature and glow of the energy core at the centre — not the metal casing, not the room

timeline.action: Fine threads of cyan light creep outward from the bright core at the centre of frame, thin as hair.
The threads branch like synapses; small nodes ignite where they meet; a few violet and cool white threads weave between the cyan ones.
Soft pulses travel along the filaments toward the edges while the lattice slowly breathes back to the density of the opening second.

shots.camera: locked-off, extremely slow push-in (about 3% scale over the whole clip), lens centred on the core
shots.lighting: self-emissive only; the core is the single light source; gentle bloom; no rim lights, no environment
shots.composition: core exactly centred; filaments fill the central 70% and fade to black before the edges
shots.motion: slow, organic, constant speed; nothing enters or leaves the frame
shots.mobile: recorte central 9:16 feito pelo `prod:ingest` — o núcleo fica no centro seguro
shots.transitionIn: aparece por opacidade quando a rede 3D começa a se abrir (capítulo 2)
shots.transitionOut: dissolve quando a rede se recolhe para virar a casca do ecossistema
shots.integration: camada `screen` sobre o mundo 3D no capítulo Inteligência; o preto vira transparente

shots.title: Ecossistema — atmosfera orbital
shots.objective: Atmosfera volumétrica por trás das órbitas dos produtos — profundidade e escala sem disputar atenção com os painéis.
shots.goal: Slow ribbons of cyan and violet aurora-like light drifting through deep empty space, with very sparse glowing dust, on pure black.

timeline.action: Two faint ribbons of cyan light drift diagonally across the upper half of the frame, folding slowly like silk.
A thinner violet ribbon crosses behind them at a different depth; tiny dust motes catch the light.
The ribbons keep drifting at the same speed and thin out until the frame matches the opening second.

shots.lighting: the ribbons are the only light; soft volumetric falloff; never brighter than mid-grey
shots.composition: light concentrated in the upper and central area; lower third almost black (space for interface panels)
shots.motion: very slow, constant drift; no flashes
shots.transitionIn: entra junto com a órbita no início do capítulo 3
shots.transitionOut: sai quando a câmera desce para a corrente de blocos

shots.title: Inovação — fibras da infraestrutura
shots.objective: Sugerir infraestrutura própria e dados em trânsito sob a corrente de blocos — luz correndo por canais finos, em macro.
shots.goal: Macro view of pulses of light racing through fine parallel glass-fibre channels that recede toward a vanishing point, on pure black.

timeline.action: Dozens of hair-thin fibre channels lie in parallel, receding into the distance; short pulses of cyan light run along them toward the horizon.
Some pulses split at junctions and continue on two channels; an occasional violet pulse travels among the cyan ones.
The pulse rhythm stays constant and returns to the spacing of the opening second.

shots.camera: low angle, very slow forward dolly along the fibres, constant speed
shots.lighting: only the pulses emit light; fibres faintly visible where pulses pass; deep black elsewhere
shots.composition: vanishing point at the centre; fibres occupy the lower 60% of the frame
shots.transitionIn: aparece quando a câmera desce sob as órbitas
shots.integration: camada `screen` sob a corrente de hashes e a árvore de Merkle

shots.title: Futuro — horizonte de luz
shots.objective: Encerrar com amplitude: um horizonte de luz que nasce atrás de todo o ecossistema.
shots.goal: A wide dark horizon where a thin line of cyan dawn light slowly widens and brightens, with faint grid lines on an endless plane in the foreground, on pure black.

timeline.action: A razor-thin line of cyan light sits on the horizon in the lower third; faint perspective grid lines on the plane converge toward it.
The horizon glow widens gently upward with a soft violet edge above the cyan.
The glow settles and eases back to the width of the opening second.

shots.camera: static wide shot, eye level with the horizon
shots.lighting: only the horizon line emits; gradient falloff into black above and below
shots.composition: horizon at the lower third; upper two thirds stay dark for the closing headline
shots.transitionIn: entra quando a câmera recua para o plano geral do Futuro
shots.transitionOut: permanece até a experiência liberar a página
shots.integration: camada `screen` atrás do plano final e dos CTAs

shots.title: Teaser vertical 1/3 — entrar no núcleo
shots.objective: Peça para redes sociais: continua exatamente do último quadro da abertura do site.
shots.goal: The camera pushes straight into the blazing energy core; its light opens into a vast space of branching light filaments.

timeline.action: Slow push-in toward the bright core at the centre; the metal plates slide out of frame at the edges.
The camera passes through the light; on the other side, filaments of cyan light branch into a neural lattice around the lens, still moving forward.

shots.camera: single forward dolly, constant speed, centred
shots.lighting: the core is the light source; exposure locked even when passing through the light
shots.composition: vanishing point centred for the whole shot
shots.transitionOut: termina em movimento para frente — a próxima cena começa deste último quadro

shots.title: Teaser vertical 2/3 — seis luzes em órbita
shots.objective: A rede se organiza em seis luzes de cores distintas orbitando o núcleo — o ecossistema.
shots.goal: The neural lattice gathers into six small glowing spheres of distinct colours slowly orbiting a bright central core.

timeline.action: Continuing the same forward motion, the filaments draw together into six points of light.
The six lights — sky blue, cyan-green, violet-magenta, orange-amber, cyan-violet and emerald — settle into one thin elliptical orbit around the core; the camera slows and rises slightly.

shots.camera: forward drift slowing to a gentle rise, no rotation
shots.lighting: core and six spheres are the only light sources
shots.composition: core centred; orbit fills the central 80% of the width
shots.transitionOut: termina com a órbita estável vista levemente de cima

shots.title: Teaser vertical 3/3 — a esfera se fecha
shots.objective: Fechar o teaser na assinatura: as luzes voltam ao núcleo e as placas metálicas se fecham formando a esfera ATS — o primeiro quadro do site.
shots.goal: The six orbiting lights spiral back into the core and the armoured metal plates close around it, sealing the metallic sphere.

timeline.action: The six lights spiral inward along the orbit and merge into the core.
Curved armoured plates slide in from the edges and lock together around the glowing core, settling into the closed sphere of the last frame.

shots.camera: slow pull-back that ends exactly on the framing of the provided last frame
shots.lighting: core glow dims as the plates close; cyan seams stay lit
shots.composition: sphere centred, matching the last frame
shots.transitionOut: termina no quadro de abertura do site — o teaser faz loop com ele
